title: Mica for Mac and Linux
intro: Mica now runs on more computers.

items.title: Mac and Linux versions
items.text: Mica is now available for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) and Linux (AppImage and .deb). Same look, same features, same extensions. Get them at iscooliscool.github.io/mica.

items.title: Small fixes
items.text: New tab wallpapers load more reliably.

title: Passwords, printing and folders
intro: Here's what changed in this update.

items.title: Built-in password manager
items.text: Mica offers to save passwords when you sign in and fills them in when you click a login box. They're encrypted with your Windows account. Find them under ⋮ → Passwords, or import them from Chrome.

items.title: Mica's own print window
items.text: Ctrl+P now opens Mica's print window with a live preview. Choose a printer or Save as PDF, pick pages, layout, paper size and more.

items.title: Bookmark folders
items.text: Make folders right on the bookmarks bar, put folders inside folders, and pick a folder when you add or edit a bookmark. Right-click a folder to rename or delete it.

items.title: Videos keep playing behind menus
items.text: Opening a menu or the memory meter no longer freezes the video you're watching.

items.title: What's new, right here
items.text: After each update, Mica shows you what changed. You can open this again any time from ⋮ → What's new.

items.title: Extension popups stay open
items.text: They no longer flash and close, and they size themselves to fit.

items.title: New tabs open at the end
items.text: The + button and Ctrl+T put the new tab at the end of the strip.

items.title: Side panels stay visible behind menus
items.text: ChatGPT and other extension panels no longer go blank when a menu opens.
